rule.description: **检查点**: 对上游 vllm 接口（如 KV Connector base class）的封装类，其 `__init__` 方法参数必须与上游保持一致

antipattern.code:
KVConnectorFactory.register_connector(
    "UCMConnector",
    "vllm_ascend.distributed.ucm_connector",
    "UCMConnector")  # 实际类名是 UCMConnectorV1，不是 UCMConnector


class UCMConnectorV1:
    def __init__(self, ...):
        ...
